title: Action-to-stage fit

questions.text: Is this action appropriate for where the account actually is in the buying/expansion process?

criteria.text: the kind of action fits the current stage
criteria.guide: Compare the action type and ask with the stage the evidence supports, not the CRM label alone.

criteria.text: the action addresses the active blocker before moving on
criteria.guide: When a blocker (e.g. security review) is active, a step that ignores it does not fit the stage.

failure_examples: demanding executive commitment during early discovery
asking for another discovery call when security review is the active blocker
continuing commercial follow-up when the customer is in recovery/support risk

diagnostics.name: too_early
diagnostics.when: the action belongs to a later stage
